slide1.title: An integrated security system
slide1.description: Edarah protects businesses and public facilities with trained security teams, on-site guarding, electronic monitoring, and security plans tailored to each facility.

WhyUs.title: In a market where security services appear identical on the surface, the difference is made by what lies beneath.
WhyUs.description_intro: At every site we manage, we deliver an integrated security ecosystem featuring:
WhyUs.card1_desc: Comprehensive security coverage for diverse clients across commercial, industrial, residential, and government sectors.
WhyUs.card2_desc: We build long-term relationships with our clients based on mutual trust and a deep understanding of their needs.
WhyUs.image_desc: Our personnel adhere to unified uniforms and strict behavioral standards, reflecting a professional image worthy of our clients' trust.

PeopleQuality.title: Security begins with the people behind it.
PeopleQuality.description: Every site is supported by carefully selected security personnel, continuous practical training, and direct field supervision. Clear standards and close follow-up help our teams respond with discipline and professionalism.
PeopleQuality.image_alt: Edarah security officer standing inside a commercial facility

ProposalDownload.title: Explore Edarah’s security capabilities.
ProposalDownload.description: Download our company profile for an overview of Edarah’s integrated security services, including guarding, electronic surveillance, risk management, and specialist training for public and private sector facilities.

SpecializedEnvironments.title: Trained for specialized environments.
SpecializedEnvironments.description: From healthcare and industrial sites to commercial and residential communities, we tailor each security plan to the facility. Our personnel receive practical preparation for site duties and the situations they may face, supported by clear supervision and follow-up.
SpecializedEnvironments.feature_1: Security plans tailored to each sector
SpecializedEnvironments.feature_2: Training in first aid, crowd management, and emergency response
SpecializedEnvironments.feature_3: Qualified field supervisors and ongoing monitoring
SpecializedEnvironments.image_alt: Edarah security officer inside a commercial facility

CallToAction.title: Protect your facility with a plan built around it.
CallToAction.description: From on-site guarding and electronic surveillance to risk assessment and specialist training, Edarah provides integrated security solutions tailored to each facility and sector.

meta.title: Security Services | Edarah Security Services
meta.description: Security guarding, electronic surveillance, event security, personal protection, risk assessment and security training for public and private sector facilities.

hero.title: Security expertise across every environment.
hero.description: We build security plans around the demands of your industry and facility, delivered by trained teams with clear supervision.
hero.photo1_alt: Edarah security officer patrolling a shopping mall
hero.photo3_alt: Edarah security officer conducting an entry check

programs.title: Professional security programs with clear scope and accountable execution.
programs.description: Every service is structured around the facility type, operating hours, traffic patterns and the standards your site needs to maintain.
programs.note: Site assessments and custom plans available.

guarding.title: Security Guarding
guarding.desc: Fixed posts or mobile patrols, set according to the nature of each site. Uniformed, supervised teams secure entrances, perimeters and daily operations.
guarding.b1: Fixed guard posts and mobile patrols
guarding.rec: Malls, residential compounds, factories and government facilities that need a consistent, visible presence.

surveillance.title: Electronic Surveillance & Control Rooms
surveillance.desc: Surveillance cameras linked to a central control room for continuous monitoring and documentation of activity across your site.
surveillance.b1: CCTV linked to a central control room
surveillance.rec: Large or multi-entrance sites where visibility and a documented record matter.

events.title: Event & Occasion Security
events.desc: Flexible, temporary security coverage for exhibitions, conferences and large events, with teams able to move quickly and manage crowds.
events.rec: Exhibitions, conferences, seasonal events and large bookings.

personal.title: Personal Protection
personal.desc: Qualified protection teams that escort and secure VIPs according to precise security protocols.
personal.rec: Executives, guests of honor and high-profile visits that require discreet, disciplined protection.

risk.title: Risk Assessment & Management
risk.desc: We assess security risks at your facility and deliver preventive plans built on the findings.
risk.rec: Facilities launching or reviewing their security setup and wanting a clear, evidence-based plan.

training.title: Security Training
training.desc: Specialized qualification programs that raise the field readiness of security personnel.
training.rec: Organizations that want their own security staff trained to professional standards.

quality.title: Security begins with the right people.
quality.subtitle: Selected, trained and supervised.
quality.description: The human element is the real difference in any security system. Every candidate passes a rigorous screening process before joining field teams, and every site is overseen by qualified supervisors.

screening.title: Careful screening
screening.desc: Security and conduct record checks, physical fitness and emergency-handling ability before deployment.

training.title: Ongoing training
training.desc: Guarding basics, crowd management, first aid and emergency response.

supervision.title: Field supervision
supervision.desc: Qualified supervisors follow performance standards and keep management updated instantly.

discipline.title: Uniform & discipline
discipline.desc: A unified uniform and clear behavioral standards that reflect a professional image.

sectors.title: Facilities we keep secure
sectors.description: From hospitals and factories to malls and residential towers, our teams are prepared for the demands of each environment.

healthcare.title: Healthcare
healthcare.desc: Hospitals and medical facilities, with access control and round-the-clock emergency department coverage.

commercial.title: Commercial
commercial.desc: Malls, offices and stores, balancing effective protection with a smooth visitor experience.

industrial.title: Industrial
industrial.desc: Factories, warehouses and operating sites, with focus on entry control and protecting high-value assets.

residential.title: Residential
residential.desc: Compounds and towers that give residents peace of mind without affecting their privacy.

government.title: Government
government.desc: Government entities and facilities, in line with the highest compliance and governance standards.

events.title: Events & Occasions
events.desc: Temporary, flexible coverage for exhibitions, conferences and major events.

construction.title: Construction & Projects
construction.desc: Site access control, protection of equipment and materials, and follow-up of safety requirements.

process.title: A clear process from contract to deployment.
process.description: A step-by-step approach that moves smoothly from agreement to field execution, without gaps.

s1.title: Initial assessment
s1.desc: A site visit to review entry and exit points and identify risks specific to your activity.

s2.title: Security plan design
s2.desc: A tailored plan covering staffing levels, deployment points, patrol schedules and escalation.

s3.title: Approval & contracting
s3.desc: Plan review with you and a signed agreement covering service levels and responsibilities.

s4.title: Field deployment
s4.desc: Qualified personnel deployed on site, with monitoring and reporting active from day one.

s5.title: Continuous review
s5.desc: Regular performance reviews, with the plan updated as your risks or activity change.

cta.title: Protect your facility with a plan built around it.
cta.description: Tell us about your site and we will recommend the right mix of guarding, surveillance and supervision.

Footer.description: Edarah Security Services has provided integrated protection for public and private sector facilities since 2007. Our services include guarding, electronic surveillance, risk management, and specialist security training.
